scope: Reconcile pertinent verified R1–R9 functional/native model and condition decisions; all rounds retain no publication-worthy surviving finding. Restricted lane source contents are excluded. This is reuse, not a new reanalysis or campaign exhaustion.

judgments.decision: USZ22 TAF15::NR4A3 and USZ23 native EWSR1::NR4A3 contexts retained; USZ23 versus USZ20 donor independence unresolved. Existing 4/8/12-day drug/DDR curves, fibers/pATR conditions and published time dependence are prior art, not withdrawal recovery. MUG creator mesenchymal-CHS context and disputed H-EMC-SS remain unsuitable as authenticated native EMC.

UCL two pre/post-RT RNA donors, IMMUNOSARC four EMC with distinct three-paired RNA/blood subsets, Galitskiy immune case, CIVO one author EMC and generic PDO/PARIS/CUP sources retain their prior identity/access/condition limits. TNT paired immune donor RMS is unsuitable. No unchanged failed routes reopened.

Campaign no-finding dispositions, source-specific pending coverage and ownership/access restrictions reused; no restricted source scientific reopening. Other-cancer or generic/model aliases cannot substitute for native EMC.

One author EMC CAM donor/technical eggs does not establish independent PDT response; spontaneous regression alternative retained. Published sequential clinical responses, engineered fusion splice biology and existing model drug endpoints are prior art. No splice-form question reopened.

Complete USZ40/NCC221+24 source condition screens retained as already evaluated. Redox-adjacent responses lacked lipid/rescue measurements. Twelve TempO calibration and static expression questions remain shelved; no reuse as dynamic recovery endpoints.

Functional and QPOP source gates remain bounded no-finding with unresolved generic identities/condition access. Native Brenca12 plus five paired frozen conditions and eleven engineered aliases stay pending for IR-specific capture/mapping; no IR/APA/static panel reopening.
